name: Saturating Sutures makes periodic damage refund the next Sanguine Mend (#1912)
contract: Saturating Sutures 504098's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Saturating Sutures 504137, a native aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -101 and EffectSpellClassMask (524288, 0, 0) - exactly the nine Sanguine Mend ranks. Spell.dbc gives 504098 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated no entry and the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Your periodic damage and healing has a $h% chance to reduce the cost of your next Sanguine Mend by $504137s1%' and the record's own ProcChance is 15, which is left untouched. STATISTICAL BUDGET: 504137 lasts only 8000 ms (DurationIndex 31), so the assertion can be satisfied only by a proc that happens while its polling window is open or in the 8 s before it; events that fire earlier are worthless. The window is therefore placed over live ticks. Crimson Tide is cast as rank 504134, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h; its single effect is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with Amplitude 3000 and DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms), so five tick rounds fall inside the 16000 ms poll. Its EffectRadiusIndex is 13 = 10.0 yards (SpellRadius.dbc) around the caster and MaxAffectedTargets is 10, so all eight dummies stand at 2-9 yards and every one of them is inside the radius: 5 x 8 = 40 periodic-damage events. Two heal-over-time auras are fixtured on the Bloodmage for the same window, because the tooltip covers healing too and SpellTypeMask 3 in the row is PROC_SPELL_TYPE_DAMAGE | PROC_SPELL_TYPE_HEAL: Sacrificial Rite 800786 effect 1 and Purified Blood 704121 effect 1 are both aura 8 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL with Amplitude 1500 and DurationIndex 8, and AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicHealAurasTick raises PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC on the caster for each tick, adding 2 x 10 = 20 events. The Bloodmage's health is lowered first so the ticks are real heals. That is about 60 events at 15%: P(no proc) = 0.85^60, under one in seventeen thousand, and under one in three thousand even if only one of the two heal auras applies. NOT covered: the size of the discount - this asserts that 504137 is granted, and its -101% SPELLMOD_COST amount is native data, not the fix.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No cost reduction before any tick
Leave room for the fixtured heal-over-time ticks to land
Fixture: a 1500 ms periodic heal (Sacrificial Rite 800786 effect 1)
Fixture: a second 1500 ms periodic heal (Purified Blood 704121 effect 1)
Crimson Tide, immediately before the polling window
DISCRIMINATING: periodic damage and healing granted the Sanguine Mend discount
